release.body:
## Features

- **Auto Start:** Now Shizuku can start the service on boot on rootless devices too
  - Shizuku can automatically grant itself `WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS` permission if user wishes to
- **Stealth:** Shizuku tries to hide itself from some invasive apps to bypass / circumvent detection by generating random folder names and deleting the starter file once the service is started
- **Rooted debugging:** Shizuku now supports ADB Root on `userdebug` and `eng` builds

## Chore

- Dependency updates
  - Bump Kotlin version from `1.8.0` to `2.1.20`
  - Bump Compile and Target SDK from `33` to `35`
  - Bump Java compatibility version from `17` to `21`


## Fixes

- This Release fixes a regression on older android versions where adb root option is not hidden
- Adds buffer time for user to grant pop-up allowing adb-debugging (auto enable option will be added later)
- Fixes multiple regressions in older versions of android where auto-start failed to work
